author: Da_cake_dood
body: Hey Mods. I have something to talk to you. I'm so sorry I don't know how to post on forums. So i can only say what i want to say here. Hopefully you see this. The reason i'm writing this is I am ban and i Want you guys to unban me. It's been almost a year since i have been banned. The reason i was ban is because i have been talking trash to RefuseToSink a moderator at that time. First of all, sorry RefuseToSink. It's been almost a year and i really regreted my decision. I don't understand why some people use hacks and they get temporary banned but me, just talking trash about RefuseToSink gets permernantly banned. I'm sorry if there the ban appeal format is wrong but i really hope that i would be unban. Please unban me. I'm sorry for what i have done. I miss this server a lot.

title: Ban appeal

replies.author: hasl
replies.body:
Hello,

You were permanently banned for ban evading the account xxIgnacicoxx which was banned for Compromised Account. Your ban was in 2014 so I am going to give you another chance, however remember going on another account if you're banned on a main/alt you will be banned as well.
-Appealed

Regards,
Auratix_,
Senior Moderator
